source: The default engines of the garage (engine garage G1, out/engine_garage_design.md 4.1). One row per engine file the garage offers; rg::EngineStore reads this table and lists the player's user engines (extends one of these) directly after their default. Everything an engine says about itself (idle, limiter, fuels, a curve engine's peak figures) is read from its own file through the physics loader and is NOT typed here. What a file cannot say is here: the display name, the class (curve = a WOT torque curve, mapped = a simulated engine with measured maps, cycle = a simulated engine whose maps are generated from its cycle model), the family text, the card image, the mass (the swap's chassis-mass delta) and, for the simulated engines that have no curve, their peak figures measured with the engine dyno (ps::drivetrain::run_dyno_sweep, ISA sea level, wide open; tests/unit/test_engine_catalog.cpp re-measures them in a hidden [long] case). Paths are relative to the repository root. Card images are shared placeholders until engine art exists (only the inline-four and the inline-six have pictures). Masses are ASSUMED [AS] from published figures of comparable engines: no citation was fetched.
